title: ገጠር - Geter
logline: Growing up side by side with my brother in the green Ethiopian countryside, in a home that always had coffee and was never empty.
audience: Classmates and peers watching together in class, and Ethiopians who grew up in rural places and miss them
intent: Warmth, reflection and nostalgia: viewers who grew up in the countryside should feel their own childhood home again
style_block: hand-painted gouache illustration, lush green Ethiopian highland countryside, soft golden morning light, warm earthy palette, gentle film grain, faces simplified and stylised (not portraits), subject centred in frame

characters.description: an Ethiopian highland boy of about ten, slim, warm brown skin, short tightly curled black hair, faded green short-sleeved cotton shirt, knee-length khaki shorts, black plastic sandals
an Ethiopian highland boy of about the same age, slim, warm brown skin, short tightly curled black hair, faded red short-sleeved cotton shirt, dark blue shorts, barefoot

voice.style: soft and slow, like waking up

shots.reason: Establish the place and its peace before any people appear
shots.image_prompt: green rural valley at dawn, flowering trees, thatched round houses, thin morning mist over the fields, birds in the sky
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in, mist drifting, birds crossing the sky

narration.text: ያደግኩት ገጠር ነው። ጠዋት ስነቃ የወፎች ዝማሬና የአበቦች መዓዛ ይቀበለኝ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: I grew up in the countryside. Each morning, birdsong and the scent of flowers greeted me.

shots.reason: Sensory detail (bees on blossoms) carries us from waking into the village waking
shots.image_prompt: branch of a flowering tree in close-up, white and yellow blossoms, honey bees on the flowers, soft background blur
shots.motion_prompt: camera static, bees moving between blossoms, petals trembling in a light breeze

narration.text: የጫካ ንቦች በአበቦቹ ላይ ሲያንጎራጉሩ፣ መንደሩም ቀስ ብሎ ይነቃ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: As forest bees hummed over the blossoms, the village slowly woke.

shots.reason: Everyday village life: animals, work and the river that later shots return to
shots.image_prompt: cattle walking out to a green field, a donkey and a horse carrying loads on a dirt path, women washing clothes at a river bend in the distance
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan left to right, cattle walking, river water flowing

narration.text: ከብቶች ወደ መስክ ሲወጡ፣ ከወንዙ ላይ እናቶች ልብስ ያጥቡ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: As the cattle went out to pasture, mothers washed clothes upstream.

shots.reason: Introduce my brother and the bond: a shared daily task, side by side
shots.image_prompt: two boys seen from behind walking side by side on a grassy path toward a spring, each carrying a yellow water container
shots.motion_prompt: camera follows slowly behind them, grass moving in the wind

narration.text: እኔና ወንድሜም ውሃ ለመቅዳት ጎን ለጎን ወደ ምንጩ እንሄድ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: And my brother and I walked side by side to the spring to fetch water.

shots.reason: Play and joy: a lighter beat after the chores
shots.image_prompt: two boys playing football in an open green field, a homemade ball, cows grazing nearby watching
shots.motion_prompt: camera static, the boys run after the ball, a cow turns its head

narration.text: ውሃውን አድርሰን፣ ከብቶቹ እያዩን ሜዳ ላይ ኳስ እንጫወት ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: With the water home, we played football in the field as the cattle watched.

shots.reason: Freedom of the river; downstream answers the upstream image in s03
shots.image_prompt: boys swimming and splashing in a shallow river, late afternoon light, trees along the banks
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in, water splashing gently, light glittering on the river

narration.text: ቀኑ ሲሞቅ ደግሞ ወደ ወንዙ ታች ወርደን እንዋኝ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: And when the day grew hot, we went down the river to swim.

shots.reason: Holiday tradition shared with friends; the qetema carries us into the home
shots.image_prompt: children gathering bundles of fresh green qetema grass and tall grass in a meadow, holding the bundles in their arms
shots.motion_prompt: camera static, children lifting bundles of grass, grass swaying

narration.text: በዓል ሲቃረብ ከጓደኞቻችን ጋር ቄጠማና ረጃጅም ሳር እንሰበስብ ነበር፤
narration.subtitle_en: When a holiday drew near, we gathered qetema and tall grass with our friends,

shots.reason: Warmth of home: the qetema on the floor and the coffee ceremony
shots.image_prompt: traditional coffee ceremony on a floor covered with fresh green qetema grass, a black clay jebena on glowing charcoal, small cups on a tray
shots.motion_prompt: camera static, steam and incense smoke rising slowly

narration.text: ቄጠማው ቤት ውስጥ ሲጎዘጎዝ፣ ቡናው ይፈላ ነበር።
narration.subtitle_en: and as the qetema was spread through the house, the coffee brewed.

shots.reason: The family proverb, given room to land: the film's central idea
shots.image_prompt: a small cup of coffee on a wooden tray, steam rising, soft window light
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, steam curling upward

narration.text: እንደሚባለው፣ ቡና የሌለው ቤት፣ ባዶ ነው።
narration.subtitle_en: As they say, "A house without coffee is empty."

shots.reason: Close on belonging: the same valley at dusk answers the opening and the proverb
shots.image_prompt: the same green rural valley at dusk, warm light in the round houses, smoke rising from a roof, flowering trees in silhouette
shots.motion_prompt: slow pull-back, smoke rising, light fading

narration.text: የእኛ ቤት ግን ባዶ ሆኖ አያውቅም። የእኔና የወንድሜ ሥር ዛሬም እዚያው ገጠር ነው።
narration.subtitle_en: But our home was never empty. My brother's roots and mine are still there, in the countryside.

end_card.text: Made with AI tools. A true story, shared with my brother's consent.
